data.one_liner: A page slider with parallax design for onboarding flows.
data.what_it_does: Provides a page slider widget with a parallax background design that moves at a different speed than the foreground content. It includes a bottom indicator, skip button, and customizable finish button.
use_when: You need an app introduction or onboarding screen flow
You want a parallax background sliding effect behind page content
avoid_when: You need a general-purpose image carousel for media galleries or banners
You require complex state management solutions within the onboarding pages
strengths: Parallax background design with adjustable speeds
Built-in bottom page indicators and skip/finish buttons
weaknesses: Limited to basic onboarding slider features
No documentation on advanced page controller extensions

alternatives.name: carousel_slider
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick carousel_slider if you need a versatile image/content carousel rather than a dedicated onboarding flow.

data.minimal_example:
OnBoardingSlider(
  totalPage: 2,
  speed: 1.8,
  pageBodies: [
    Text('Page 1'),
    Text('Page 2'),
  ],
  background: [
    Image.asset('assets/slide_1.png'),
    Image.asset('assets/slide_2.png'),
  ],
)
